providerVerification.question: Bharosa Hai providers ko kaise verify karta hai?
providerVerification.answer: Providers profile details aur documents submit karte hain. Admin team identity, category fit, credentials aur profile quality review karti hai.

free.question: Kya Bharosa Hai use karna free hai?
free.answer: Customer access prepare ho raha hai. Launch phase mein provider onboarding free hai.

compare.question: Kya main multiple providers compare kar sakta hoon?
compare.answer: Homepage discovery first ke liye prepare hai. Customer features launch hone par comparison workflows add honge.

becomeProvider.question: Verified provider kaise banun?
becomeProvider.answer: Provider account banayein, profile complete karein, required documents upload karein aur admin review ka wait karein.

cities.question: Currently kaun se cities supported hain?
cities.answer: Launch focus Mathura, Vrindavan, Agra, Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad aur Sonipat par hai.
